scope: Theorem 7.5 (Construction summary) of the manuscript “The Partition Principle does not imply Choice” (preprints/The-Partition-Principle-does-not-imply-Choice-September-24-2026/partition-principle-without-choice.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 244 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 7101fb4828d8d2ba), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 37. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Let V be a ground model of ZFC, put κ = ωV 1 , µ = (2ℵ0 )+V , |I|V = µ+ , and use the monoid of Theorem 2.2 and the symmetric system constructed above. In an ordinary generic extension for its product forcing, the resulting symmetric model W satisfies W |= ZF + PP + ACWO + ¬AC. It contains V and has the same ordinals as V . It adds no countable sequences of ground elements: if b ∈ V and z ∈ W is a function ω −→ b, then z ∈ V . The set of labels A is not wellorderable in W, and PW (A) \ {∅} is an explicit family in W with no choice function in W.
